payload.justification: The door is locked and the unlock action requires carrying a matching item, but the inventory is empty. The box is a visible container that may hold an item usable on the door.
payload.expected_outcome: The box opens and reveals its contents, which may include an item to carry.
payload.subgoal: Open the box to look for a key or item
plan: Inspect the contents of the box
Pick up an item that may match the door lock
Unlock the door with the matching item
Verify the actor is outside the room
